title: Tower Isles
summary: An artillery party round on a composed level: a ruined tower on the middle island with a plaza round it, a gatehouse on the next island and a bridge between them, all of them ground that bombs carve on every screen; the seats in pairs that see each other and the tower.

verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from tower-isles, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (186 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU; tests/terrain-two-players.mjs <dir> --landmark: host and joiner over WebRTC hold the same ground after real bomb clicks aimed at the tower, the tower lost the same samples on both screens, a late joiner gets it (9 of 9 steps)
